findings.issue: שֵׁבֶט (construct) stays open among rod, staff, tribe, and scepter; «cetro» narrows it to a specialized royal instrument and adds an object beside the brothers.
Construct אֹהֶל plus the article on הָעֵדֻת licenses the definite tent of the testimony; bare «tienda» leaves that definiteness unstated.

notes: אִתָּךְ is marked 2fs while the imperative is 2ms; «contigo» stays 2sg and does not shift person.
